title: The Triangle & its Properties
description: Class 7 IMO — The triangle and its properties: medians and altitudes, the exterior angle property, the angle sum property, the Pythagoras theorem and triangle inequalities.

topics.title: Medians, Altitudes & Angle Sum
topics.concept:
When a transversal crosses two parallel lines, 8 angles are formed with special relationships:

Angle PairRelationshipExamples
CorrespondingEQUAL1=5, 2=6, 3=7, 4=8
Alternate InteriorEQUAL3=6, 4=5
Alternate ExteriorEQUAL1=8, 2=7
Consecutive InteriorSum = 180 degrees3+5=180, 4+6=180

Consecutive interior angles are also called co-interior or same-side interior angles.

PARALLEL LINES WITH TRANSVERSAL:

     1 | 2
    ---|---  L1
     3 | 4

     5 | 6
    ---|---  L2
     7 | 8

Corresponding (equal): 1=5, 2=6, 3=7, 4=8
Alternate interior (equal): 3=6, 4=5
Alternate exterior (equal): 1=8, 2=7
Consecutive interior (sum 180): 3+5=180, 4+6=180

examples.problem: How many medians does a triangle have?
What is an altitude perpendicular to?
If angle 1 = 70 degrees, find angles 5, 3, and 6.
examples.solution: Angle 5 = 70 deg (corresponding). Angle 3 = 70 deg (vertical to angle 1). Angle 6 = 110 deg (consecutive interior: 70+110=180).

examples.problem: Alternate interior angles are (3x+20) and (5x-40) degrees. Find x.
examples.solution: Alternate interior angles are equal: 3x+20 = 5x-40 => 60 = 2x => x = 30.

recap: Median: vertex to midpoint; altitude: perpendicular from a vertex.
Consecutive interior angles SUM to 180 degrees

quiz.q: How many medians does a triangle have?
The angles of a triangle add up to ___ ?
quiz.explanation: The angle sum of a triangle is 180°.

topics.title: Exterior Angle Property
topics.concept: The exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the two opposite (interior) angles. So if the two opposite interior angles are 60° and 70°, the exterior angle is 130°.

examples.problem: Interior angles 60° and 70°. Find the exterior angle.
An exterior angle is 110° and one opposite interior angle is 50°. Find the other.

recap: Exterior angle = sum of the two opposite interior angles.

quiz.q: The exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the two ___ interior angles.
quiz.explanation: It equals the sum of the two opposite interior angles.

quiz.q: Interior angles 45° and 55° give an exterior angle of ___ ?

topics.title: Pythagoras Theorem & Inequalities
topics.concept:
In a right-angled triangle, the Pythagoras theorem states hypotenuse² = base² + height². So legs 3 and 4 give a hypotenuse of 5.

The triangle inequality says the sum of any two sides must be greater than the third side.

examples.problem: A right triangle has legs 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse.
Can sides 2, 3 and 6 form a triangle?
examples.solution: No, because 2 + 3 = 5 is not greater than 6.

recap: Triangle inequality: any two sides sum to more than the third.

quiz.q: A right triangle has legs 5 cm and 12 cm. What is the hypotenuse?
Can sides 2 cm, 3 cm and 6 cm form a triangle?
quiz.explanation: 2 + 3 = 5 is not greater than 6, so no.

questions.q: The exterior angle of a triangle equals the sum of the two opposite ___ ?
questions.explanation: Exterior angle = sum of the two opposite interior angles.
